crossRefs.note: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned…
Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom…
Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh’s law, and all Israel with him.
The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt; for he grew exceedingly…
He took courage, built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, with the other wall…
Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose, and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.
The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be…
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
